dataset.name: Anti-PD-1-treated metastatic melanoma (DFCI, 2019)
dataset.description: Independent metastatic melanoma cohort with pretreatment bulk RNA-seq and survival measured from anti-PD-1 initiation.
dataset.cohort_context: Treatment-selected metastatic melanoma; pretreatment biopsies from patients subsequently treated with PD-1 blockade.

metadata.study_design: Pretreatment biomarker cohort for anti-PD-1 therapy

samples.sample_role: Pretreatment metastatic melanoma biopsy used for bulk RNA sequencing

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same supplied symbol are averaged sample-wise before log2(TPM + 1); different identifiers are never merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The DataHub molecular-profile metadata identifies the frozen source values as RNA-seq TPM. TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) after requiring finite non-negative values. Biopsy-context labels relative to prior ipilimumab are retained when the specimen still predates anti-PD-1; the single On-PD1 transcriptome is excluded.

endpoints.label: Progression-free survival
endpoints.event_definition: Progression or death as encoded by the source PFS status
